_comment: W5 INJECT probe (D82). Proves the SMV write primitive + the frame-boundary injection machinery headless with NO game (probe conf = empty autoexec): boot trap (BPLM on the BDA tick cell 0x46C) -> arm (BPDEL * + BPINT 8) -> boot_writes (SMV into the classic 0x500-0x51F DOS/BIOS scratch area BEFORE frame 1) -> per-frame inject rows: a plain seam write at frame 1 and frame 2 (marker bytes), a command-ring append at frame 3 (count cell 0000:0510, records at linear 0x520, stride 0x10 — the 0x4dd4a0/0x46cbe0 ring mechanics against low memory) -> readback watches dump the SAME cells each frame so the gate script asserts write-then-read ordering and the count increment. The injected frames must carry the DBXCAP 'frame N 1' flag. These ids are deliberately NOT registry ids - a probe transcript is never stitched.
